comparison.objective: Commission a rigid-body damper versus attach a cable to fish tape and pull it through conduit.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed hex-key insertion and collar locking versus deformable hook-and-eye engagement and hand-over-hand pulling.
comparison.success_condition: Repeated safe impact absorption with retained setting versus the hooked eyelet and cable emerging from the far conduit mouth by at least 5 cm.
comparison.reason: The cable task tests deformable routing and hook retention, not mechanism tuning or impact response.
